_comment: The daily image queue. A brief is due when its lane's last accepted asset for that id is older than `every` days, so nothing here needs editing to keep the queue alive. `name` is the path under src/<lane>/<day>/ and, when the lane publishes, under published/<lane>/<day>/. `every` is the freshness promise; `site` also carries the page the asset belongs to.

site.intent: a hero, og card or icon for bountystash.com, matt.bountystash.com or concept.bountystash.com

wall.intent: a desktop wallpaper for a dwl session on a 1024x600 or 1920x1080 panel, either clean flat vector or 4k realistic neumorphism

fleet.intent: a nixconfig fleet illustration: docs art, an agent card or a topology figure

briefs.name: og/console.png
briefs.prompt: A brutalist developer console rendered as a flat vector poster: a single monospaced-looking block of abstract code lines on off-white paper, one cyan accent rule, hard 90-degree geometry, generous margins, no readable words, no logos, no people.

briefs.name: og/matt.png
briefs.prompt: Minimal editorial card for a personal engineering portfolio: a large off-centre circle in warm ochre on warm grey paper, one thin black horizontal rule crossing it, flat ink texture, no text, no faces, wide aspect.

briefs.name: og/concept.png
briefs.prompt: Concept mockup card for a bug-bounty platform: abstract layered terrain contour lines in deep indigo on pale sand, one small bright signal dot with a faint halo, flat vector, no text, no UI chrome, no people.

briefs.name: case/nixos-fleet.png
briefs.prompt: A declarative infrastructure figure as flat vector art: eight small identical server blocks wired to one root node by perfectly orthogonal lines, muted teal and graphite, uniform stroke weight, isometric-lite, no labels, no perspective distortion, lots of white space.

briefs.name: hero/console.png
briefs.prompt: A wide abstract texture for a website hero: a fine grid of hairlines warped slightly at the centre like paper under pressure, off-white on warm grey, one soft cyan bloom, flat, no text, no objects, no figures.

briefs.name: icons/marks.png
briefs.prompt: A four-by-four contact sheet of sixteen simple geometric marks: circles, chevrons, brackets, dots, each drawn in one stroke on its own off-white tile with even gutters, black ink only, uniform weight, no letters, no numbers.

briefs.name: hero/quiet.png
briefs.prompt: A calm wide background for a quiet technology website: soft horizontal bands of extremely desaturated blue and sand, a single thin horizon line, flat colour fields with a faint paper grain, nothing else, no text.

briefs.name: og/work.png
briefs.prompt: An index card for a work listing: a neat stack of three offset rectangles in muted sage, cream and graphite, one corner folded, flat vector with a soft long shadow, no text, no people, wide aspect.

briefs.name: ridge-fog.png
briefs.prompt: A desktop wallpaper: five layered mountain ridges receding into fog, muted catppuccin mocha palette on a deep charcoal #1e1e2e base, flat vector with soft gradient mist, the left third kept empty and dark for desktop icons, no text, no birds, no people.

briefs.name: dunes.png
briefs.prompt: A desktop wallpaper: minimal sand dunes as two smooth overlapping curves, warm sand and dusty rose against a deep charcoal #1e1e2e sky, flat vector with a soft grain, horizon in the lower third, no text, no objects, no people.

briefs.name: fjord.png
briefs.prompt: A wide desktop wallpaper for a short landscape panel: a fjord read left to right, a pale mint water channel running horizontally through the middle distance, two low dark cliff masses entering from the left and right edges, catppuccin mocha palette on deep charcoal #1e1e2e, a narrow calm sky strip above, flat vector with subtle horizontal banding, no tall vertical cliffs, no text, no boats, no people.

briefs.name: grid-horizon.png
briefs.prompt: A wide desktop wallpaper: a perspective grid floor under a charcoal #1e1e2e sky, the horizon placed about two fifths of the way down from the top so the floor owns the lower frame, no more than seven horizontal lines spaced ever wider toward the viewer and only four lines converging on the horizon, a muted mauve line colour on deep charcoal, flat vector, even stroke weight throughout, restrained synthwave without neon glare, no dense mesh, no fine hatching, no moire, no text, no sun, no cars.

briefs.name: bamboo-tall.png
briefs.prompt: A portrait desktop wallpaper: silhouetted bamboo stalks in three depth layers, muted green and charcoal, soft light between the stalks, flat vector with paper grain, no text, no animals, no people.

briefs.name: circuit-city.png
briefs.prompt: A wide desktop wallpaper: a city skyline drawn as a circuit board, each building a solid rectangular block with one or two thick traces leaving its roof, no more than twelve traces across the whole frame and none thinner than one hundredth of the image width, graphite on deep charcoal #1e1e2e with a single teal accent path, flat vector, silhouette first and circuit second, no small pads, no thin lines, no fine hatching, no windows detail, no text, no people.

briefs.name: night-train.png
briefs.prompt: A desktop wallpaper: a long train window at night reduced to a horizontal band of soft blurred lights over deep charcoal #1e1e2e, two thin rails of pale grey at the bottom, flat vector, impressionistic not photographic, no text, no people, no faces.

briefs.name: terrace-tall.png
briefs.prompt: A portrait desktop wallpaper: a bare stone terrace looking out to a hazy sea, three pale horizontal bands for sky, water and stone, one potted plant silhouette at the lower right, flat vector, muted terracotta and slate, no text, no people.

briefs.name: orbit.png
briefs.prompt: A desktop wallpaper: a small planet at the lower right with two thin orbital rings, deep charcoal #1e1e2e field, pale blue and dusty pink rings, flat vector with a faint star scatter that stays out of the left third, no text, no spacecraft, no people.

briefs.name: rain-glass.png
briefs.prompt: A wide desktop wallpaper: rain on window glass over an out-of-focus city at night, thick drops and a handful of long vertical runs instead of a fine drizzle, every streak at least one hundredth of the image width, large soft bokeh discs of teal and amber rather than small dots, deep charcoal #1e1e2e base, flat vector approximation, calm and low contrast, the bottom third kept quiet and nearly flat, no fine texture, no text, no people, no faces.

briefs.name: frieren-neumorph.png
briefs.prompt: Frieren, 4k, realistic, neumorphism.

briefs.name: knight-neumorph.png
briefs.prompt: An armored knight, 4k, realistic, neumorphism.

briefs.name: desk-4am.png
briefs.prompt: A taxi dashboard at 4am, 4k, realistic, neumorphism.

briefs.name: crt-sand.png
briefs.prompt: A CRT monitor half-buried in sand, 4k, realistic, neumorphism.

briefs.name: docs-hero.png
briefs.prompt: A wide banner for a technical documentation site: a lattice of thin connected nodes forming a gentle arc, graphite lines on warm off-white, three nodes filled teal, uniform stroke, flat vector, no text, no icons, no people.

briefs.name: agent-card.png
briefs.prompt: A square card image for an autonomous agent: a single matte geometric form like a folded plane, graphite and teal on warm grey, one soft shadow, flat vector, minimal, no text, no faces, no robots.

briefs.name: cache-map.png
briefs.prompt: A flat vector diagram of a content-addressed cache: three concentric arcs of small identical blocks with arrows only on the outermost arc, muted blue and grey on off-white, uniform stroke, generous margins, no labels, no text.

briefs.name: graph-lattice.png
briefs.prompt: A knowledge-graph illustration: a sparse lattice of nodes and edges with four clusters, graphite on pale stone, two clusters tinted teal and ochre, flat vector, even spacing, no text, no labels, no people.

briefs.name: microvm-stack.png
briefs.prompt: A square illustration of a hypervisor host running three guest machines: one large plate with three smaller plates stacked above it at an angle, muted teal and graphite, flat vector, thin outlines, no text, no logos, no people.

briefs.name: terminal-texture.png
briefs.prompt: An abstract wide texture for a terminal-themed page: evenly spaced short vertical tick marks of varying height along the bottom, rising into empty charcoal, muted green fading to nothing at the top, flat vector, no text, no characters, no people.
